scope: Four new font files x five new realizations from the same moderate mapping generator x 180 familiar classes, one common view per glyph. Not unseen generator families, arbitrary fonts, or new character recognition.
seed_scope: Initialization-only replicates; one common fixed crop schedule across all six jobs and HOG. No prediction ensemble.
selection: No further selection. Evaluate final step5000 only, all six jobs. Test scoring allowed only after every Point checkpoint and both HOG prototype files are frozen.
hog: Use all 80000 crop events; ideal uses ideal mapping each event; MMA uses the same five-way per-step mapping routing as Point multi. Mean within font/class/map, equally mean fonts, then mean maps. No five-fold augmentation of mapping exposures. Cache only identical row/point/mapping with exact multiplicities.

statistics.primary: window Skeleton-MMA-HOG minus mean-of-three Point-multi accuracies
statistics.bootstrap_unit: character; keep fonts, mappings and all seeds together
statistics.ci: percentile95; conditional on fixed fonts/maps/initializations; not seed-population uncertainty
statistics.secondary: Point multi-minus-ideal paired by seed; Skeleton and Canny MMA gains; report secondary intervals as exploratory
statistics.aggregation: macro-average all four fonts/five maps; average scalar Point accuracies over seeds, never logits/votes
statistics.seed_report: each seed and sample SD across three initializations

font_distribution: Private research artifact. Font binaries omitted; public release needs a separate rights check or new preregistered open fonts.
